::: {#sol-path-length}

63 times,
once for each of characters 2 to 64.
Whatever the network keeps about the first character has to survive all 63 updates,
and its [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) has to pass back through all of them in training,
where it can [vanish](backpropagation.qmd#def-vanishing-gradient).
Attention can connect the last position to the first in one step,
if the queries come from the same sequence as the keys.

:::
